name: SIA 223 起落架问题 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 223. You have an undercarriage problem, you'd like to go around, inform Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 223。你的起落架出现问题，希望复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, undercarriage problem, go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，起落架出现问题，复飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, climb and maintain 900 meters, turn left heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，爬升至并保持 900 米，左转航向 330。
cards.referenceText: climbing to 900 meters, left turn heading 330, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 900 米，左转航向 330，SIA 223。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, confirm you want to make another approach or join holding pattern?
B: Tell the controller you will have to hold for a while to sort out the problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，确认你希望再次进近还是加入等待航线？
B： 告诉管制员，你必须等待一段时间以排除故障。
cards.referenceText: request hold, sort out the problem, SIA 223.

cards.audioText: SIA 223, maintain 900 meters, direct to DAL A, contact approach 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，保持 900 米，直飞 DAL A，联系进近 119.35。
cards.referenceText: maintain 900 meters, proceed to DAL A and contact approach on 119.35, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 900 米，前往 DAL A，联系进近 119.35，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: now you are on emergency, you are unable to lower the nose gear, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你处于紧急状态，无法放下前起落架，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 223, emergency, unable to lower nose gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 223，紧急情况，无法放下前起落架。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, roger, fly heading 080.
B: read back the instructions and tell the controller you would like to make a low pass for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，收到，飞航向 080。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员你希望实施低空通场，以便进行目视检查。
cards.referenceText: heading 080, request low pass for visual check, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向 080，请求低空通场进行目视检查，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared low pass left of Runway 36R over the apron, expect Runway 04 for emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可在 Runway 36R 左侧、机坪上空实施低空通场，预计使用 Runway 04 紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: cleared low pass on the left side of Runway 36R over the apron, emergency landing Runway 04, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 左侧、机坪上空实施低空通场，使用 Runway 04 紧急着陆，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Tower you are turning onto the ILS for a low pass for Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉塔台，你正在切入 Runway 36R 的 ILS，以实施低空通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, ILS for a low pass Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，正在切入 Runway 36R 的 ILS，以实施低空通场。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, Wuhan tower, report on final approach.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，武汉塔台，最后进近时报告。

cards.audioText: Now you are on short final.
SIA 223, I say again, cleared low pass over the left of Runway 36R, I'll keep you advised.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，我再说一遍，许可从 Runway 36R 左侧低空通场，我会随时向你通报。
cards.referenceText: roger, cleared low pass on the left hand side of runway, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可从跑道左侧低空通场，SIA 223。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, the nose wheel doesn't appear to be down, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you ask for touch and go and you intend to jar the wheel down.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，前轮看起来没有放下，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你请求接地复飞，并打算通过震动将机轮放下。
cards.referenceText: SIA 223, request touch and go, jar down.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 223，请求接地复飞，尝试通过震动将机轮放下。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared touch and go, heading 330, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可接地复飞，航向 330，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared touch and go Runway 36R, turn left heading 330, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 接地复飞，左转航向 330，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: you are going around, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在复飞，向武汉塔台报告。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, roger, climb and maintain 600 meters, heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，收到，爬升至并保持 600 米，航向 330。
cards.referenceText: left turn heading 330, climb to 600 meters, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330，爬升至 600 米，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: your nose wheel still appears to be jammed, tell the controller you have to make an emergency landing on Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的前轮看起来仍然卡住，告诉管制员你必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, nose wheel still appears to be jammed, we have to make an emergency landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，前轮看起来仍然卡住，我们必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, the emergency group is ready.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，紧急救援组已就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，SIA 223。
